reviews.title: Horrible Pop-ups
reviews.text: I have enjoyed using this app as a daily reference tool; however, recently I have encountered numerous pop-ups while reading Scripture. Many of these require me to close the passage and start over. I do not believe this is an appropriate way to manage a Bible app, nor does it reflect the teachings of the very Scripture it is intended to provide.

reviews.title: The “X” needs to be removed
reviews.text:
The “X” in the top corner of the app needs to be removed.  
When you click on it it closes the bible entirely and you have to open it back up and try and find your spot again.  
Its placement in the top left corner causes me to close out where I am at and I have to start over again.  
Why?  Example, I’m reading through a passage and I click on the word to see what the Strongs says about it.  When I’m done I want to get out of that window and back onto the passage I was reading.  In many popular apps out there to close a pop up window and get back to the previous screen you go up to the top left or right and click an “X” to close that window and you are back to what you were just looking at.  

In this app however that “X” closes everything and there is no way to get back to where you were,  it’s highly frustrating.
